## What and why

Describe the problem and the user-visible change. Link the relevant issue.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and anything you could not verify. Use synthetic data
in screenshots or fixtures.

- [ ] Focused regression coverage added for nontrivial behavior changes
- [ ] `npm run check`, `npm test`, and `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run check:native` for native/IPC/recovery changes
- [ ] Relevant docs and changelog updated
- [ ] Dependency/runtime changes include license and compatibility review
- [ ] No credentials, private workflows, generated installers, or signing files

## Compatibility and risk

Describe changes to saved documents, exported workflows, model/tool permissions,
unsaved drafts, or platform behavior. State migration or rollout needs.
